title: When doubt keeps fogging the path under pressure
issueStatement: The mind keeps second-guessing what it once knew clearly enough to begin. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru answers doubt by clarifying what is worth trusting, keeping, and repeating. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Stop circling and let Guru's word take residence. Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once.
actionPrompt: Return to one clear line before reopening every question at once. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
